items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after some meals, which can be associated with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person. Walking 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain: 17.5 mg/dL less.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Only 12.5% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, which is good because sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Keep having most of your dinners before 8 pm.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 10.1 hours, which is a good start. In the program, some people had an overnight fast of 13 hours, but it's not clear how this affects sugar levels yet.
